name: io.github.chrischall/app-store-connect-mcp
description: App Store Connect MCP server for Claude — apps, TestFlight, customer reviews, sales reports, and team users

environmentVariables.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: 10-character App Store Connect API Key ID (e.g. ABC1234567).

environmentVariables.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Team Issuer ID (UUID) from App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations.

environmentVariables.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your downloaded .p8 private key file. Either this or APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY is required.

environmentVariables.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PEM contents of your .p8 private key. Either this or APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH is required.
